about:
Cut validation by minimizer plus full Fisher, Roman cosmic shear or 3x2pt.

For one IA model, one cut K0 (k_UV = K0/D(z), masks_n1) and one FLAMINGO
truth, with every parameter of the chains free (5 cosmological, 8 Delta z
with N(0, 0.002), 8 m with N(0, 0.005), the IA parameters):
    data     d = GG(D3A) + xi_IA^FLAMINGO(truth), noise free, the GG of the
             chain's own theory (emulmps + cosmolike, use_emulator 2)
    ref      theta_ref: D3A, Delta z = m = 0, the IA parameters fitted to d
             at fixed cosmology (the reference the bias is measured from)
    Fisher   F = J^T J + P at theta_ref, J the derivatives of the whitened
             data vector (central differences, absolute steps), P the
             Gaussian priors; flat priors left out. sigma(Omega_m, S8) is
             marginalized over all the other parameters.
    min      the maximum a posteriori from theta_ref and 2 starts drawn from
             F^-1 (scipy least_squares, trust region with the flat prior
             bounds, the same J); its shift of (Omega_m, S8) from D3A has no
             projection effect. mu = shift/sigma_F, FoB = sqrt(dp C^-1 dp).
    linear   the Fisher prediction of the same shift, F^-1 J^T r(theta_ref).
--fisher-only stops there (Kable, Addison & Bennett 2019, arXiv:1908.01626,
Eq. 6): FoB = the linear shift with the flat priors as Gaussians, no
minimizer; key suffix |fisher. --hscale s multiplies every derivative step
(key suffix |h<s>), the step-size check. TATTz: TATT with one A1 and one A2
per source bin and one shared b_TA. The reference fit of NLAz and TATTz gets
a second start when one A1_i falls off its neighbours' trend (trend_restart:
the A1 ~ 0 basin of II); the lower chi2 is kept and recorded as ref_restart.
A singular F (parameters the data do not see, no_info) leaves only the
flat-prior Fisher.
Models: NLA (A1, eta1 power law), NLAz (NLA with one A1 per source bin,
IA_redshift_evolution 2), TATT (A1, eta1, A2, eta2, bTA), and the halo-model
variants NLAa and TATTa: NLA or TATT with the A1 terms on
I_1 P_lin + alpha (P_NL - I_1 P_lin) (GI) and P_lin + alpha (P_NL - P_lin)
(II), alpha free in [-1, 2] (physical range 0 to 1). Their data vector is
cosmolike's native NLA or TATT (emulator pipeline, every parameter) plus
(1 - alpha) sum_s [A_s U_GI[s] + A_s^2 U_II[s]], A_s = A1 ((1+z_s)/1.62)^eta1,
the templates of hm_templates.py, held at the D3A cosmology; their gamma_t
rows scale with the lens bias b_i/B1_FID_i.
NLAf and TATTf hold alpha at FLAMINGO's own value per snapshot instead,
from the halo-model refit of notes/flamingo_vs_tng300 (fits/
hmc_alpha_fits.json, a_c <= 1, no satellites, k_max = 0.70) in the same
form as the Roman model: TATTf the TATT form (variant alpha_cap_nosat,
ALPHA_FLAMINGO_TATT), NLAf the NLA form (A2 = b_TA = 0, variant
nla_alpha_nosat, ALPHA_FLAMINGO_NLA); alpha is anticorrelated with b_TA,
so the two differ. NLAfT is NLA with the TATT-form values, a test of the
sensitivity to alpha. The snapshots outside the core z = 0.2 to 2,
unreliable there, take the nearest core value. The correction is
sum_s (1 - alpha_s) [A_s U_GI[s] + A_s^2 U_II[s]].
NLAh and TATTh are HMc (alpha = 0, no free halo-model parameter); NLAb and
TATTb put the A1 terms on P_lin (I_1 + I^beta_cm) and P_lin (1 + I^beta_cc),
the nonlinear halo bias of analysis/halo_nlbias (templates U_GI_nlb, U_II_nlb
of hm_templates.py), also with no free halo-model parameter.
    --check-hm [truth]  compares the same template sum for native NLA (N_GI,
                N_II) of that truth's templates (default prod) with the
                emulator pipeline's NLA, cs and 3x2, and exits.
Probes:
    cs     xi_+- at K0, the example1 covariance (cov_example1_xi.npy)
    3x2    xi_+- at K0, gamma_t of sources behind lenses at K0 = 0.3, w at
           K0 = 0.2 (masks of v9/ia_base_3x2_common.npz), its Gaussian 3x2pt
           covariance, the 8 linear biases free in [0.4, 4] (truth B1_FID of
           cocoa/driver3x2.py), lens Delta z = source Delta z, Limber for
           gamma_t and w (as the base the IA vector comes from), the IA part
           of the data xi_ia of v9/ia_base_3x2_<truth>.npz (xi_+- and gamma_t)
    2x2    as 3x2 without xi_+-: gamma_t of sources behind lenses at K0 (K0
           is the gamma_t cut here) and w at 0.2, the same covariance and
           parameters; the cut of the lens probes on their own
    +cmb   Gaussian priors at D3A of the width of Planck 2018 on n_s (0.0042),
           Omega_b h^2 (0.00015) and H0 (0.54); none on A_s or Omega_m.
Run from ~/cocoa/Cocoa after start_cocoa.sh:
    python <this> [--probe cs|3x2|2x2] [--cmb] [--gt K] [--w K] [--gbias NAME] <model> <K0> <truth> [...]
--gt sets the gamma_t cut (default 0.3; K0 sets the xi_+- cut), --w the w cut
(default 0.2; key suffix |w<K>), --gbias NAME adds the nonlinear-bias vector
galaxy_bias/gbias_dv_NAME.npz to the 3x2pt data (key suffix |gbNAME).
Each run appends to fisher_minimize.json, key <probe>[+cmb]|<model>|<K0>|<truth>[|gt<K>]
(the first cosmic-shear runs, without prior, are under <model>|<K0>|<truth>).
